policy.description:
The Real Payment Headaches B2B Companies Face

When B2B clients approach us at https://t.co/CCkMbhSuFb, it's seldom about chasing "more crypto." They come because their payment stack is bleeding cash or stalling growth.

We see these issues repeatedly:

Cross-border fees that pile up relentlessly. Beyond the advertised rate, intermediaries, FX spreads, bank charges, and manual exception handling add hidden drag.

Settlements too slow for business velocity. In B2B, days-long delays kill momentum—especially when you're pushing to scale.

Sudden banking restrictions that blindside you. Geographies, merchant types, or counterparties can trigger limits overnight, stranding your operations.

Rigid fund management with no wiggle room. Teams need seamless ways to accept, hold, convert, and deploy capital—without engineering a full treasury team.

Client demand for options that match their world. In key verticals, crypto is already table stakes for a growing chunk of users.

policy.title: Tether's new USAT stablecoin just recently went live with Anchorage Digital with federal compliance
policy.description:
Tether's new USAT stablecoin just recently went live with Anchorage Digital with federal compliance under the GENIUS Act.

This matters because federally compliant stablecoins unlock institutional use cases that offshore assets can't reach in the U.S. 

Banks, payment processors, payroll providers, & public fintech apps cannot integrate unregulated stablecoins. USAT operates under bank grade compliance & onchain transparency with federal charter supervision.

USDT serves global cross border payments & emerging market liquidity. USAT targets U.S. institutions, regulated exchanges, & compliant fintech infra. Different markets, different compliance paths. Both are necessary for a full digital economy.

Institutional DeFi, tokenized treasuries, & RWA markets need federally approved settlement assets. Without them, these sectors remain structurally capped in the U.S. regardless of how good the 'tek' is. 

USAT is one attempt at making sure crypto's stablecoin innovation has mass adoption by ensuring the U.S. financial system can actually connect to it.

policy.title:
💰 Regulated Stablecoins Enter Market

Tether Introduces USAT: Tether has launched USAT (USA₮), a fed
policy.description:
💰 Regulated Stablecoins Enter Market

Tether Introduces USAT: Tether has launched USAT (USA₮), a federally regulated dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. as the first federally regulated stablecoin issuer under the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency. The stablecoin operates within the GENIUS Act framework, remains backed 1:1 by USD, and uses Cantor Fitzgerald as the designated reserve custodian. It offers on-chain transparency along with bank-grade compliance aimed at institutional users. Paolo Ardoino, CEO of Tether, stated: “USAT offers institutions an additional option: a dollar-backed token made in America.” Bo Hines, CEO of Tether USAT, said: “Our focus is stability, transparency, and responsible governance, ensuring that the United States continues to lead in dollar innovation.” USAT is currently available on Bybit, https://t.co/Mw8vpcqcZ6, Kraken, OKX, and Moonpay. Read More.
